verdict.rationale: Copilot documents 'Browse with Copilot', which acts directly in Microsoft Edge by clicking, typing and navigating tabs. Actions run locally, the user can watch each step and take control at any time, and Copilot asks for supervision before sensitive actions. Cowork is described as handling multi-step tasks. However, this operation is limited to the browser; the Word, Excel and Outlook integrations are in-app assistance, not the assistant operating applications on the computer. Missing for 10: documented ability to see and operate native desktop applications beyond Edge, detail on what Cowork actually controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration of computer-use reliability.
